subject: YCC Weekly: Bulldog Block Party Sunday, Twirl discount night
text:
YCC WEEKLY | Week of October 15

1) BULLDOG BLOCK PARTY
Sunday, October 18, 4-7pm on Old Campus. Free food, fall tote bag painting, and live performances from student groups. Bring a friend.

2) TWIRL STUDENT DISCOUNT NIGHT
Tuesday, October 20 at Twirl (New Haven). 20% off pasta bowls for Yale students. Two seatings, 5pm or 7pm. Sign-up is required and seats are limited. Sign up through the form on our Linktree.

3) YCC SENATE
Senate meets every Sunday at 12:30pm in Poorvu 120A. All interested students are welcome to attend.

Questions? Reply to this email.
Yale College Council
